source: Pre-registered benchmark (2026-11-21): plain time-series momentum, parameters fixed from the literature, not fitted to this data

preregistration.hypothesis: Crypto perpetuals keep trending at multi-week horizons (time-series momentum): long when the 30-day return in volatility units is above +0.5, short below -0.5, flat when it crosses zero.
preregistration.why_these_parameters: 30-day lookback and 30-day volatility on 4h candles (180 bars) is the standard monthly TSMOM horizon; entry at half a volatility unit, exit when momentum turns; a wide 4xATR catastrophic stop, no take profit, no break-even or ratchet, no structural genes. Nothing here was optimised.
preregistration.role: The bar every research strategy must beat on the forward test. It is never re-optimised and never removed from the forward book.
preregistration.decision_rule: Research is only worth its complexity if the top quartile's forward return beats this benchmark over the same period (reported in /api/forward).
